policy: Fixed retrospective walk-forward validation of existing rules, not a fresh holdout; all periods have previously been inspected. No parameter search.
fold_boundary_policy: Liquidate at last close of each fold, restart flat; no P&L carried over gaps. Formation expands from 2023. First signal uses first evaluation close and fills at the next close.
cost_model: Self-financing target weights after costs; one-way total bps split into 1 bp fees, 2 bp half-spread and remaining slippage. Borrow 5% actual calendar days/365; cash earns zero.
earnings_timing_policy: Only source-supported release sessions may enter audited path. Scheduled dates alone do not verify actual publication. Unreviewed/conflicting/ambiguous events explicitly excluded. Exact timestamps not inferred.
performance_inference: Descriptive only; no performance p-values or confidence intervals from dependent small samples. Engle-Granger raw and BH values retained for every candidate/fold; global BH diagnostic also reported.
